question: In return for help in protection of 1,272 hectares of a badly degraded Sal forest, villagers were given employment in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Silviculture.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **West Bengal Forest Department recognized** in 1972 that it had not been successful in restoring the **damaged Sal forests** in the state's southwest regions.
 
• The** protection of 1,272 hectares of severely degraded sal forest **was made possible by the vision of a forest officer, **A.K. Banerjee, and the locals.**
 
• **Villagers received employment in silviculture** and harvesting, 25% of the final harvest, and permission to collect fuelwood and fodder for a small price in exchange for their assistance with protection.
 
• **Silviculture:**
 
 
• The **process of managing a forest's growth, composition, and quality in order to achieve goals and needs—most notably, the production of lumber**—is known as silviculture.
 
• The words** silvi- (meaning "forest") and culture (meaning "growing"**) are Latin roots of the term. Silvology is the study of forests and woods.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Agriculture:**

 
 
• It is the **science or art of farming, which includes raising animals for food, wool, and other goods and tilling the soil for crop growth.**
 
• It has been the** primary source of livelihood for a large percentage of the population** for centuries.
 
 
 
• **Sericulture:**
 
 
• It is the** practice of silk farming**, which involves the cultivation of silkworms and the production of silk.
 
• The raising of silkworms, the gathering of silk cocoons, and the processing of silk fibres are all parts of sericulture.
 
• **Types of silk:**
 
 
• Mulberry Silk.
 
• Tasar Silk.
 
• Muga Silk.
 
• Eri Silk.
